heading: Intern table — rules add no strings
text:
### Intern table — rules add no strings [LNLS.5.5]

No expression in a `linear_scan: false` program produces a novel string at
run time ([LNLS.3.2]), so no rule action adds an entry to the intern table
after DSC load.

[LNLS.3.2] does not reach a String slot value that arrives on an asserted
fact. The engine may intern such a value when it pumps the fact, so the table
may grow during the operational phase. Where the table is locked
([RTCT.12.4]), the engine refuses that intern with `DS_ERR_OOM` instead of
growing the table.
